Anchors the repo-level UNKNOWN route: _unreachable_signals() rebuilds the full repo-level set from empty data so coverage, not luck, sets confidence.

Second, structurally different UNKNOWN route: repo resolves clean but the issue does not exist, so every contention signal is missing. required_dims=('contention',) must veto a repo-only ENGAGE. This is the partial-fetch case — the one where a false-green is cheapest to produce, because the data that DID arrive all looks good.

Before sig_repo_open the pipeline never read repo['archived'] and scored this byte-identical to facebook/react: ENGAGE risk 0.05 conf 0.87. GitHub REFUSES pull requests on an archived repo, so contribution is impossible, not risky. Adversarially chosen so no unrelated signal (push recency, owner age) can produce the right answer by accident.

Discriminating pair with alibaba/fastjson: same ground truth, different accidental signals (push 4 months stale). Kept so a future regression that flags archived repos via staleness instead of the archived flag still shows up as a divergence between these two rows.
